issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event uses shorthand labels S1 (B-a1b0 driver), S2 (B-0c07 real arm), and Conversational Texture uses S4 prime build, but none of these labels are defined anywhere in the text — a new reader cannot tell whether S1/S2/S4-prime mean story steps, sprints, or something else in the B1-B15 program labeling scheme
